name: Zones
intent: Give cards, notes, tokens, or running state a labelled place on the page.
when: sorting pieces into stages, or keeping several live threads in view
prompt: Place or write into the zones as the session moves; update them when something changes.
readback: Zone membership and what is written in each zone is the finding; note anything stuck between zones.

claims.claim: Items placed inside the same bounded region are perceived as belonging together, even against other grouping cues, so labelled zones make category membership readable at a glance.
claims.construct: the Gestalt principle of common region (perceptual grouping)

grounding.helps: when cards, notes or tokens need a labelled home on the page and the categories are genuinely distinct; items inside the same box tend to be seen as a group
grounding.backfires: when the categories are not really distinct, so the zones freeze a premature taxonomy and manufacture false tidiness, and when an item sits across a border and its zone becomes ambiguous
